name: Google Agent Platform Sandbox (Code Execution / Shell / Computer Use)

modes.label: Code Execution / Shell sandbox (API exec, same Agent Compute + Agent Memory meter)
modes.note: Same published meter ($0.085/vCPU-h + $0.009/GiB-h allocated, per-second). Code Execution: Python or JavaScript (LANGUAGE_PYTHON / LANGUAGE_JAVASCRIPT), two fixed shapes (default 2 vCPU/1.5 GB, or 4 vCPU/4 GB), "limited file system and no network access", preinstalled libraries only ("You can't install your own libraries"), no snapshots, state kept up to 14 days (TTL configurable; execute_code resets the TTL). Shell sandbox: "a managed, isolated Linux container" reached through an /exec API, not SSH; its vCPU/RAM shape is not published.

modes.label: Computer Use sandbox (managed browser, billed as Agent Compute + Agent Memory)
modes.note: Pricing page (2026-09-28): "Runtime and Sandbox environments, including Code Execution and Computer Use, are billed on Agent Compute (vCPU-hours) and Agent Memory (GiB-hours)... vCPU resources allocated... $0.085/vCPU-h... Memory (RAM) resources allocated... $0.009/GiB-h. All usage is rounded to the nearest second." This regime is the Computer Use sandbox: a containerized browser driven via API actions / Chrome DevTools Protocol with a VNC live view. Not an SSH VM; a full desktop beyond the browser is not documented.

modes.commit_note: Spend-based 1-year Flexible Savings Plan (consumption model 7754-699E-0EBF per page); opt-in; commitment amount/minimum not stated on pricing page.
modes.note: Pricing page Flexible Savings Plan 1-Year column: 10% off Agent Compute and Agent Memory.

modes.commit_note: Spend-based 3-year Flexible Savings Plan; opt-in; commitment amount/minimum not stated on pricing page.
modes.note: Pricing page Flexible Savings Plan 3-Year column: 20% off Agent Compute and Agent Memory.

plans.name: Usage based
plans.note: Unknown limits are not promises of unlimited capacity.

features.ip_note: Computer Use sandbox only (code-execution sandbox has no network); runs in Google Cloud, no proxy/stealth/CAPTCHA options documented; screen API covers the browser, not a full OS desktop.

caveats: One meter, three sandbox types: Agent Compute $0.085/vCPU-h + Agent Memory $0.009/GiB-h (allocated, per-second) covers Agent Runtime, Code Execution, Shell and Computer Use sandboxes (Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform, formerly Vertex AI Agent Engine). The Runtime idle-between-turns exemption applies to Runtime only, not to sandboxes.

None of these is an SSH-able VM: Computer Use is a containerized browser (API actions / CDP / VNC view); Code Execution is Python-only with no network access; Shell sandbox runs commands through an API. Sandbox vCPU/RAM sizes are not published.

ENGINE_CARD cannot apply all independent free CPU/RAM/storage/request allowances exactly. Raw regimes/worked example retain them; any engine subtotal may overstate charges or miss eligibility. Do not subtract them twice.

Features set to null were not verified. No sandbox was purchased or tested; feature/performance statements are documentation claims. Null maximums are unknown unless a cited note explicitly states unlimited.
A complete monthly bill requires known snapshot/egress/plan limits; do not silently treat missing ancillary charges as free.

fleet.verification: Google Cloud project, billing and required Agent Platform IAM/API setup.
fleet.tiers: Per project per region: 1,000 sandbox entities; 500 sandbox write (create/delete/update) requests/min; 1,000 execute requests/min; 10 Agent Platform resource (instance) writes/min; 100 Agent Platform resources.
fleet.notes: Computer Use sandbox quickstart is distinct from Code Execution. Reviewed quota page labels 1,000 sandbox entities specifically Code Execution; do not automatically assign that as Computer Use concurrent-machine allowance. New-account fleet quota/increase process not established.
